name: powerbi-desktop
description: AI-assisted local Power BI Desktop and Fabric engineering workbench with Enterprise AI features: Fabric workspace inventory planning, Power BI Service scanner, gated TOM/TMSL write plans, report layout auto-fix plans, semantic test runner, performance trace import, VertiPaq import, screenshot UX review, governance policy packs, AI change journal, model risk heatmap, release candidate pack, 12-USP Max AI review, PBIP Apply Engine, native BPA, model compare, and live DMV analysis.

interface.shortDescription: AI workbench for local Power BI Desktop projects.
interface.longDescription: Adds an AI-assisted Power BI Desktop workbench for local projects and open Desktop sessions: Enterprise AI release candidate packs, Fabric workspace inventory planning, Power BI Service scanner, gated TOM/TMSL write plans, report layout auto-fix plans, semantic test runner, performance trace import, VertiPaq import, screenshot UX review, governance policy packs, AI change journal, model risk heatmap, PBIP Apply Engine for measures, calculated columns, Power Query, generic TMDL, and report pages; native BPA rules, native model compare, native model documentation, DAX performance and VertiPaq-style heuristics, live DMV analysis, report render-readiness checks, calculation group drafts, relationship drafts, RLS role drafts, Power Query/M drafts, service integration planning, incremental refresh drafts, aggregation drafts, schema-aware visual planning, report layout checks, theme audit, PBIP source-control planning, PBIP report page and visual authoring drafts, PBIP-to-PBIX compile workflows, optional external-tool awareness, live XMLA/ADOMD model discovery, PBIX/PBIT/PBIP inventory, PBIP structure analysis, configurable governance rules, dependency graphs, AI prompt packs, business semantic layers, KPI trust scoring, decision-risk analysis, release gates, guided fixes, semantic diffs, measure lineage impact, generated DAX test plans, report narrative and UX critique, executive explainability, governance scorecards, Copilot readiness and optimization, release checklists, semantic metric catalogs, report UX blueprints, and safe PBIP/TMDL refactoring guidance.
defaultPrompt: Inventory this folder for PBIX and PBIT files and summarize what can be inspected safely.
Help me document the DAX measures and Power Query transformations in this Power BI project.
Run a Power BI insight scan and identify DAX risks, model smells, and the safest next actions.
Create a governed PBIP/TMDL refactoring plan for this report.
Generate a metric catalog and semantic contract for this Power BI model.
Create a report UX blueprint from the metric catalog and model summary.
Create an AI prompt pack for reviewing and improving this Power BI project.
Run a full AI review package for this Power BI project.
Run an innovation review with guided fixes, generated DAX tests, lineage impact, Copilot readiness, and release checklist.
Decide whether this report can be trusted and released using the Power BI Trust Release Gate.
Create an external tools review for Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, Power BI Helper, and pbi-tools.
Create a new PBIP report page with visuals and prepare the workflow back to PBIX.
Run native Power BI tool-parity review without relying on external wrappers.
Run real Power BI feature review for live DMVs, authoring drafts, service planning, and schema-aware visuals.
Apply safe PBIP drafts for measures, columns, Power Query, TMDL, and report pages.
Run a unified review that combines offline project review, live Desktop review, External Tool registration, and golden baseline checks.
Run the AI/KI Power BI engineering workflow with autonomous fixes, KPI trust contracts, live-vs-repo reconciliation, and Fabric readiness planning.
Run the Max AI review with all 12 AI/KI USP workflows for Power BI Desktop and Fabric engineering.
Create an Enterprise Power BI release candidate pack with service scanner, semantic tests, model risk heatmap, and PR comment.
Create a Fabric workspace inventory plan and compare service governance risks with the local PBIP model.
Create a gated TOM/TMSL write plan with dry-run, backup, diff, and rollback gates.
Run an autonomous planning loop that observes actuals, forecasts, detects gaps, simulates scenarios, creates actions, learns, and repeats.
Create a goal-seeking plan that calculates what must happen to hit the monthly budget, roll forecast, margin, or cash target.
Constrain the revenue plan by delivery, capacity, inventory, margin, cash, customer, and sales-resource feasibility.
Build a revenue digital twin from the AI forecast outputs and simulate how to close the monthly target gap.
Run an autonomous forecast agent council with backlog, demand, budget, skeptic, risk, and arbitrator perspectives.
Turn planning deviations into managed exceptions with severity, owner hints, status, next action, and closure evidence.
Turn forecast gaps into a revenue rescue action board with customer, product, owner, impact, probability, and deadline.
Design a forecast trust market that tracks human overrides, confidence, actuals, bias, and model-vs-human accuracy.
Create causal and counterfactual forecast scenarios for delivery delays, working days, backlog conversion, and customer demand.
Apply self-healing forecast governance that demotes biased models, blocks unsafe recommendations, and routes to safer baselines.
Build planning memory for forecast versions, assumptions, actions, overrides, actuals, lessons, and segment learning signals.
Score autonomous planning readiness across data quality, snapshots, matching, accuracy, constraints, overrides, and action tracking.
Create a forecast war room for executive gap review, top deltas, action ownership, status, and confidence monitoring.
Inspect the currently open Power BI Desktop model.
